description.value: San Josef Recreation Area serves as the trailhead base for San Josef Bay within Cape Scott Park, surrounded by old-growth Sitka Spruce and Western Red Cedar at Vancouver Island's remote northwestern tip; access is via logging road with active truck traffic.

The discovered URL points to bcparks.ca/cape-scott-park/ (a BC Parks page for Cape Scott Provincial Park), which is a different entity — the website mentions San Josef Bay as being within the park boundary but does not describe or confirm amenities at the Western Forest Products recreation site specifically. Because the website is for a different operator and does not describe this campsite's facilities, most amenity fields must remain null.
concerns: URL mismatch: the discovered URL (https://bcparks.ca/cape-scott-park/) is for Cape Scott Provincial Park operated by BC Parks, whereas the OSM record identifies this campsite as 'San Josef Recreation Area' operated by Western Forest Products — these are different entities with different operators.
No address, phone, or email present in OSM record; the site is very remote and may be difficult to contact or verify.
